messages:
alyssa: Quick follow-up to the canary RFC. I want to float a different fallback model Im calling 'diffuse fallback' instead of one-to-one failover: when the primary degrades, we spread small fractions of traffic across several fallback variants (e.g., quantized, previous stable, local-degraded) to avoid a single large-quality cliff and to reduce tail spikes. Thoughts?

samir: I like it. Main concerns: router complexity and more telemetry/metrics surfaces. We need a separate policy engine that computes per-route/tenant weights and enforces cost/quality budgets.

ben: Ownership question: Platform should own the policy in the DeploymentSpec and the router subscribes. Suggest a simple spec snippet: mode=diffuse, budget_cents_per_min, variants=[v1-quant,v0,local-cpu]. Router caches resolved plans.

marta: From ops: make rollback/abort synchronous and immediate. Emit audit events when weights change. Observability must show per-variant lat/err/quality and an overall rollup.

deploy-bot: :information_source: canary started canary_id=cnr-17884 service=text-gen baseline=v2 window=15m

alyssa: Implementation idea: place a fallback-broker off the hot path. It ingests telemetry (latency, error-rate, quality_signal) and runs the policy algorithm, then publishes compact weight updates to router caches over pubsub. Routers validate generation and ttl. Eventual consistency is ok within SLO slack.

samir: Algo sketch: slow proportional ramps + exponential backoff on regressions. Use reservoir counters and minimal step sizes to avoid flip-flopping. Cap by cost budget and quality budget.

ben: Quality measurement: require a quality_signal in the telemetry contract and allow a pluggable scoring hook so product teams can provide domain-specific checks (e.g., hallucination score). Redwood Optimize can provide baseline prompt-sets.

marta: Sticky sessions: diffusing traffic hurts KV-cache locality. For latency-sensitive routes support session affinity tokens for N requests so a session stays mostly on one variant and warms cache. Define eviction when variants are removed.

alyssa: Debugging: expose /rollout/explain?req=... on the broker that returns which rule fired, current weight vector, and short metric slices. Also log weight-change diffs as audit events.

samir: Ops toggle example: curl -XPOST /api/v1/flags/fallback/diffuse -d '{"enabled":true,"mode_override":"slow"}'

ben: Pubsub message shape: compact JSON with route_id, weights[], generation, ttl. Routers must validate staleness and an emergency abort flag.

marta: Add an emergency_abort flag stored in the control plane that routers check synchronously and that overrides broker weights. Also a read-only endpoint to snapshot current effective weights.

alyssa: I'll draft an RFC addendum with: DeploymentSpec additions, broker pubsub contract, telemetry contract (lat/err/quality/cost), algorithm sketch with step rules and budget-enforcement, session affinity knobs, and a short runbook for ops. Will circulate by EOD Friday. Ping me with edge cases or examples you want included. :pray:
